headline: October CPI at 8:30 AM ET today with markets pricing ~84% odds of a December Fed hike, while Brent slid near $92 on US-Iran de-escalation hopes.
rates: The 10-year yield is near 4.88% and the 2-year near 4.56%, both rising as traders lean toward a hike.
fed: The Fed held at 3.75%-4.00% on Oct 28, markets price about an 84% chance of a hike on Dec 9, and Fed speakers (Bowman today, Williams Thursday) are on deck.
oil: Brent is near $92, down about 22% from a late-October peak above $117 on hopes for a US-Iran deal, though diesel and LNG supply stay tight.
geo: US-Iran talks and Strait of Hormuz incidents remain live, and Nvidia fell 4.3% on an investigation into its CEO tied to suspected China chip smuggling.
